description.value:
Like a squox fighting off a larger predator, you know it's best to dash into dangerous encounters, focus on a single enemy, and go right for their eyes (or other optical receptors). You Stride, then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Feint], then make a melee Strike against the target of your Feint. You can use Acrobatics instead of Deception for this [[/act feint skill=acrobatics]], if desired, and the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs against your Feint if they're larger than you.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Effect: Go for the Eyes!]
